title: Maybe an interesting glimpse of future playtesting? Told Claude Opus 4.6 with Chrome tool to play my game TinyRTS and defeat the enemy town center. It struggled a bit with the map controls and precise clicking, but managed to do it after 17 minutes, completely by itself!
author: zebleck

replies.author: zebleck
